T: The best club in Harlem. The best table in the house.
D: A nightclub owner and his adopted son outfox a crooked cop and a mob boss in 1930s Harlem.
P: Serve the drinks when the craps tables open at Club Sugar Ray.
S: the dining room at the club
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, finished with paprika and chives on silver trays.
Cubes of sharp cheddar and Swiss with dots of black olive pressed in like dice, on toothpicks with crackers.
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and grated onion mixed, spooned into 175C oil and fried golden. Honey butter.
M: Buttermilk fried chicken fried at 165C until 74C inside, on crisp buttermilk waffles with maple syrup and hot sauce butter.
Thick pork chops floured and browned, simmered 40 minutes in an onion gravy made from a dark roux and stock, served with rice and greens.
W: Club Sugar Ray lemon chess pie
Short pastry with a buttery lemon custard that bakes a crackly top, served in thin slices.
K: A sugar cube soaked in bitters in a flute, topped with chilled sparkling wine and a twist of lemon.

s.note: the dining room at the club
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a dash of hot sauce. Pipe back and finish with smoked paprika and chives. Lay them on silver trays.
Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 200ml buttermilk, 1 egg and a grated onion. Spoon into 175C oil and fry until golden. Beat 60g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey to serve.

m.how: Brine 800g chicken thighs in buttermilk, dredge in flour and fry at 165C until 74C. Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 60g butter and cook waffles. Serve with maple syrup and butter melted with hot sauce.

w.n: Club Sugar Ray lemon chess pie
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs, 300g sugar, 110g melted butter, 2 tbsp cornmeal, 100ml lemon juice, lemon zest and 60ml milk. Pour into a 23cm blind-baked shortcrust case and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set. Cool completely.

d.how: Drop a sugar cube soaked in a few dashes of aromatic bitters into each of four flutes. Top slowly with chilled sparkling wine and twist a strip of lemon peel over each.
